name: Fonts designed
tagline: Four families, seventeen styles, from the mailroom.
statement: Type drawn and traced from Lorenzo Scardicchio's own hand: Lorenzo Hand, Longhand, Typewriter and Meadow, served from the mailroom on paper photographed from his desk.
summary: Lorenzo Type is four families from one desk, seventeen styles in all, each free: Lorenzo Hand, traced letter by letter from the writing on an order sheet; Lorenzo Longhand, the pen-stroke hand in Ballpoint, Graphite and Inkwell; Lorenzo Typewriter, serif and sans in Thin, Light, Regular and Bold; Lorenzo Meadow, Script, Stitched, Sans Light and Regular, and Ornaments.

steps.title: The site, page by page
steps.body: Type drawn and traced from Lorenzo Scardicchio's own hand, served from the mailroom on paper photographed from his desk. The home page is the order sheet on gingham; each family has its specimen page with a tester, every glyph and the files to take.
steps.source: the site's own description and home page

steps.title: Lorenzo Hand
steps.body: A blue-ballpoint cursive, lifted from two pages written by hand: an order sheet filled in for Far Light Gardens, and the captions pencilled beside a pressed spurge. Every word on those pages is in the font whole, as the hand wrote it, and the ligature sets the scan's own word, joins, slips and all. Three weights: Regular is the order sheet's ballpoint set a little heavier than it wrote; As Written is that ballpoint at the weight it has on the page; Fine is the thinner pen of the captions.
steps.alt: The Lorenzo Hand page: the keepsake card, the pressed plant, the tester.

steps.title: Drawn as the pen made it
steps.body: Every word and letter is redrawn from its pen strokes, not traced around the scan's ink: each glyph's ink is reduced to its centre lines, joined into strokes wherever the hand went straight on through a crossing, smoothed by a spline that may stray only a tenth of a pen width from the ink's own middle, and drawn back as discs at the pen's width. A ballpoint pools where it pauses, so in Regular each knob is put back in the ink's own shape.
steps.alt: A pressed spurge, its round leaves fanned out flat, from the scans.
steps.source: assets/lorenzo-hand/README.md (Drawn as the pen made it)

source: Fonts designed's own build photographed on 2026-10-22 (scripts/work/shoot.mjs): page titles and first words, typefaces and colours observed, the logo and pictures the pages show, the phone frames. Every word is qwarter.com's, the site's own or observed; nothing is written here. By hand (content/studies/_overrides/lorenzo-type.json): the words are the site's own (journeynudger/lorenzo: index.html, hand/index.html, the specimen pages, mailroom.html, assets/lorenzo-hand/README.md, read 2026-10-22); the pictures its own scans; photographed from its own files on 2026-10-22. The address is the one the site itself names (www.lorenzoscardicchio.com); the runner met a Cloudflare challenge there, so whether this version is live could not be checked from here. Named "Fonts designed" at Lorenzo's word (2026-10-23).
brief: The home page is the order sheet itself, on gingham: date, name, Rural Route 2 Box 17, Low Moon KS, and the four families as its lines. Lorenzo Hand is a blue-ballpoint cursive lifted from two pages written by hand, an order sheet filled in for Far Light Gardens and the captions pencilled beside a pressed spurge; every word on those pages is in the font whole, as the hand wrote it. The mailroom files the paintings, the writing and the muses, and the whole site can be read on the meadow paper instead.
